primary_reader_notes.1-2: Identifies light attenuation and diffraction. Actual production device is ZTE Axon 20, explicitly not a product-ready ZTE solution.
primary_reader_notes.3-4: Eq. 1 includes convolution, noise, clipping and tone mapping. Measured HDR PSF has a main peak and long-tail side lobes; Figure 3 brightened for visualization. No Axon 40 Ultra transmittance or PSF.
primary_reader_notes.5-7: DISCNet conditioned on PSF and degraded image, dynamic feature-domain filtering at several scales; evaluation/ablations are synthetic and do not measure the commissioned handset.
primary_reader_notes.8: Real-data evaluation is qualitative because ground truth is unavailable. Limitations explicitly include domain gap, camera noise, motion blur, defocus and computational weight.
primary_reader_notes.9-10: References inspected; no citation claims in report are based solely on these unopened referenced works.

published_crop.review: Viewed extracted crop at native resolution. It retains figure labels, color traces and original caption. Used only for mechanism explanation.

limits: No cross-device transfer of PSF support, restoration metrics, throughput or algorithm deployment claims.
